retrievalProfile.description: Use this skill for creating 1980s-style cinematic layouts featuring a central airbrushed character portrait set against a large circular sun and a dual-environment landscape base.
triggerTerms: central character with crossed arms over sunset

recipe.visualDefinition: A central, medium-shot character portrait with arms crossed, rendered in a smooth airbrushed style. Behind the character is a large, vibrant orange-to-yellow gradient sun. The bottom of the composition features a montage of two distinct locations (e.g., urban city and snowy mountains) blending into a misty foreground.
coreVisualRelationships: Character centered and overlapping a large circular sun
Typography positioned in the upper left quadrant
Dual-landscape montage forming the base of the image
Misty atmospheric blending at the character's waistline
coreInvariants: Large circular sun element behind the primary subject
Horizontal rule lines separating lines of display text
Airbrushed texture on skin and clothing highlights

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure, waist-up, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large orange sun serves as the primary geometric anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the character's face to the large title on the left, then down to the landscape details at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Purple atmospheric space in the top corners provides breathing room for the central elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep purple and violet for the sky and atmosphere.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant orange and yellow for the sun and highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Black and dark leather tones for the character's attire.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the sun element contrasting with the moody, lower-value purple background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for the title paired with a wide-tracked, minimalist sans-serif for secondary info.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rules between lines of text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, elegant serif structure of the main title.
Matches the geometric, wide-tracked metadata text at the top.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an airbrushed illustration of a man with crossed arms in a leather jacket. Behind him, a large orange circular sun against a purple sky. At the bottom, blend a city skyline on the left with snowy mountains on the right using a misty transition.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a high-contrast serif font in the upper left, using uppercase letters. Place thin horizontal lines between the lines of text. Add a single line of wide-spaced sans-serif text across the very top.

verificationChecks: Is the sun a perfect circle behind the character?
Are there horizontal lines between the title words?
Is the character's skin texture smooth and airbrushed?
Does the bottom landscape feature two distinct environments?

adjustableVariables: Landscape locations in the bottom montage
Primary sky color (e.g., teal instead of purple)
mustRedesign: Do not use existing movie titles or logos
Ensure the horizontal rules are clean and geometric

avoid: Hard edges between the character and the background mist

postGenerationChecks: Check for the presence of horizontal rules in the title area.
Verify the character is centered and overlapping the sun.
Ensure the bottom landscape is split into two distinct zones.
Confirm the airbrushed aesthetic is consistent across the portrait.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central airbrushed portrait + large circular sun + dual-landscape base + high-contrast serif title with horizontal rules.
